predictions.mechanism: Greater Houthi control around Bab el-Mandeb raises shipping and energy-supply risk, reinforcing inflation and risk-off pressure on U.S. equities while yields are already near multi-year highs.
predictions.invalidation: Credible reversal of the territorial gains or a security arrangement that restores safe commercial passage and pushes oil sharply lower.

predictions.mechanism: The geopolitical shock can keep energy inflation and long yields elevated, a particularly unfavorable combination for duration-sensitive technology valuations.
predictions.invalidation: Credible de-escalation around Bab el-Mandeb together with a material fall in oil and Treasury yields.

predictions.mechanism: Europe is highly exposed to imported energy and maritime trade disruption; added Red Sea risk compounds the ECB's already hawkish energy-inflation backdrop.
predictions.invalidation: Credible de-escalation around Bab el-Mandeb and a sustained fall in European energy-risk premia.

predictions.mechanism: German cyclicals and manufacturers are sensitive to shipping disruption, energy costs and restrictive yields, all of which worsen if Bab el-Mandeb risk rises.
predictions.invalidation: Credible de-escalation around Bab el-Mandeb and a sustained fall in energy and freight costs.

predictions.mechanism: Global risk-off pressure and higher yields are negative for Australian equities, though resource exposure partly offsets the shock from stronger energy prices.
predictions.invalidation: A rapid normalization in shipping risk or a broad risk-on reversal that outweighs the geopolitical premium.

predictions.mechanism: The escalation supports safe-haven demand, but the firm dollar and Treasury yields near 5% remain powerful headwinds for gold, leaving the net signal conflicted.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive fall in yields and the dollar would favor upside; a further yield spike without broader risk escalation would favor downside.

predictions.mechanism: Silver receives some safe-haven support but also faces growth-sensitive industrial demand risk plus pressure from a firm dollar and high yields.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive broad move in precious metals driven by either falling real yields or a sharp global growth shock.
